description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractProvider' for OAuth2 service providers, including methods for authorization URL generation, token exchange, resource owner retrieval, and request handling within the league/oauth2-client library.

classes.name: AbstractProvider
classes.description: An abstract class providing core OAuth2 provider functionalities such as authorization URL creation, token exchange, resource owner fetching, and request handling, designed to be extended by specific provider implementations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the OAuth2 provider with options and optional collaborators like grant factory, request factory, HTTP client, and option provider.

methods.name: getAllowedClientOptions
methods.description: Returns a list of allowed options for configuring the HTTP client, such as timeout and proxy settings.

methods.name: setGrantFactory
methods.description: Sets the grant factory instance used to produce grant objects.

methods.name: getGrantFactory
methods.description: Retrieves the current grant factory instance.

methods.name: setRequestFactory
methods.description: Sets the request factory instance used to create PSR-7 requests.

methods.name: getRequestFactory
methods.description: Retrieves the current request factory instance.

methods.name: setHttpClient
methods.description: Sets the HTTP client instance used for sending requests.

methods.name: getHttpClient
methods.description: Retrieves the current HTTP client instance.

methods.name: setOptionProvider
methods.description: Sets the option provider instance for obtaining request options.

methods.name: getOptionProvider
methods.description: Retrieves the current option provider instance.

methods.name: getState
methods.description: Returns the current state parameter value used in OAuth flow.

methods.name: setPkceCode
methods.description: Sets the PKCE code verifier, to be used before requesting an access token.

methods.name: getPkceCode
methods.description: Returns the current PKCE code verifier.

methods.name: getBaseAuthorizationUrl
methods.description: Abstract method to get the authorization URL base.

methods.name: getBaseAccessTokenUrl
methods.description: Abstract method to get the access token URL base.

methods.name: getResourceOwnerDetailsUrl
methods.description: Abstract method to get the resource owner details URL.

methods.name: getRandomState
methods.description: Generates a random string for the OAuth state parameter.

methods.name: getRandomPkceCode
methods.description: Generates a random PKCE code verifier.

methods.name: getDefaultScopes
methods.description: Abstract method to get default scopes for the provider.

methods.name: getScopeSeparator
methods.description: Returns the separator used to join scopes in URL.

methods.name: getPkceMethod
methods.description: Returns the PKCE method used, default null.

methods.name: getAuthorizationParameters
methods.description: Builds authorization parameters, including state, scope, PKCE, and redirect URI.

methods.name: getAuthorizationQuery
methods.description: Builds the query string for the authorization URL.

methods.name: getAuthorizationUrl
methods.description: Constructs the full authorization URL with parameters.

methods.name: authorize
methods.description: Redirects the client to the authorization URL, optionally via a custom redirect handler.

methods.name: appendQuery
methods.description: Appends a query string to a URL.

methods.name: getAccessTokenMethod
methods.description: Returns the HTTP method used for token requests, default POST.

methods.name: getAccessTokenResourceOwnerId
methods.description: Returns the key for resource owner ID in token responses.

methods.name: getAccessTokenQuery
methods.description: Builds the query string for access token URL.

methods.name: verifyGrant
methods.description: Verifies or creates a grant object.

methods.name: getAccessTokenUrl
methods.description: Constructs the full URL for access token request.

methods.name: getAccessTokenRequest
methods.description: Prepares a PSR-7 request for token exchange.

methods.name: getAccessToken
methods.description: Performs the token exchange using a grant and options, returning an access token.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Creates a non-authenticated PSR-7 request.

methods.name: getAuthenticatedRequest
methods.description: Creates an authenticated PSR-7 request with a token.

methods.name: createRequest
methods.description: Builds a PSR-7 request with headers and options.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Sends a PSR-7 request and returns the response.

methods.name: getParsedResponse
methods.description: Sends a request and parses the response, handling errors.

methods.name: parseJson
methods.description: Parses JSON content, throws if invalid.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Gets the content-type header from a response.

methods.name: parseResponse
methods.description: Parses response body based on content type, supports JSON and urlencoded.

methods.name: checkResponse
methods.description: Abstract method to check for errors in response.

methods.name: prepareAccessTokenResponse
methods.description: Prepares and maps access token response data.

methods.name: createAccessToken
methods.description: Creates an AccessToken object from response data.

methods.name: createResourceOwner
methods.description: Abstract method to create resource owner object.

methods.name: getResourceOwner
methods.description: Fetches and creates resource owner object.

methods.name: fetchResourceOwnerDetails
methods.description: Fetches resource owner details from API.

methods.name: getDefaultHeaders
methods.description: Returns default headers for requests.

methods.name: getAuthorizationHeaders
methods.description: Returns authorization headers for a token.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Returns all headers for a request, including authorization if token provided.
